com.radiantlogic.iddm.ldap

Enum LdapResultCode

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<LdapResultCode>
      • com.radiantlogic.iddm.ldap.LdapResultCode
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    StatusCode, Serializable, Comparable<LdapResultCode>

    public enum LdapResultCode
extends Enum<LdapResultCode>
implements StatusCode
    Represents an LDAP result code as defined in RFC 4511 Section 4.1.9 and related extensions.

    Each result code has an integer value and a human-readable description. Use fromInt(int) to look up a result code by its integer value.

    Example usage: 

    
 final Optional<LdapResultCode> resultCode = LdapResultCode.fromInt(32);
 resultCode.ifPresent(rc ->
     log.info("Result: {} ({})", rc.asString(), rc.asInt()));
    See Also:
    RFC 4511 §4.1.9

      • fromInt

        public static Optional<LdapResultCode> fromInt(int value)
        Returns the LdapResultCode corresponding to the given integer value.

        Recognized codes include all result codes defined in RFC 4511 Section 4.1.9, server-side extensions (RFC 2891, RFC 3909, RFC 4370, RFC 4528, RFC 4533, etc.) and client-side result codes.

        Parameters:
        value - the integer result code value
        Returns:
        an Optional containing the matching result code, or empty if unrecognized

      • isError

        public boolean isError()
        Returns true if this result code represents an error condition.

        Non-error codes include SUCCESS, COMPARE_FALSE, COMPARE_TRUE, REFERRAL, SASL_BIND_IN_PROGRESS, IS_LEAF, and NO_OPERATION.

        Specified by:
        isError in interface StatusCode
